[issue by Thedzudzu]
### Bug Description

With sodium 0.8.12-alpha.1 and Supplementaries, minecraft crashes when trying to load a world.

I am using neoforge 21.1.233(latest) for 1.21.1.
I've tried the latest sodium versions, with Supplementaries 3.6.7 and 3.5.34 and for both the game crashes.
Sodium 0.6.13 runs good.
